title: Transitioning from Presumptive to Conclusive Land Titling: A Legal & Economic Blueprint for India
key_finding: Guaranteed state land titles reduce civil property court litigations by up to 68% and unlock ₹14.2 Lakh Cr in dormant land capital.

title: Socio-Economic Impact of Drone-Based SVAMITVA & NAKSHA Cadastral Surveys on Rural Credit Access
key_finding: Formal property cards issued via drone surveys increased formal bank agricultural collateral loans by 44% in pilot districts.

title: Land Value Capture (LVC) Mechanisms for Financing Urban Transit Corridors in Tier-2 Indian Cities
key_finding: Dynamic betterment levies around 3D ULPIN mapped transit stations can fund 35% of capital expenditure for metro corridors.
